item.title: Newsom, Trump unlikely allies on corporate home-buying
item.description: (Inside California Politics) — Gov. Gavin Newsom and President Donald Trump don’t often see eye-to-eye. item.title: Boy, 12, found safe after being reported missing in Stockton area
item.description: (FOX40.COM) — A 12-year-old boy was found safe after being reported missing in the Stockton area Monday evening, and sheriff’s deputies confirmed to FOX40. He was originally reported missing around 5 p.m. Monday, last seen heading westbound on Eastview Drive in Stockton. He’s considered at risk because of his age. This story has been updated.
